title: G1 golden case input (no expected scores)

zero_classification.description: Required once the workshop pins ADR-0011 classification for a zero symptom.

candidates.description: For tie cases: at least two candidates that must tie under approved scoring.

expected.description: Forbidden until G1 closes. Present only in post-approval fixtures.

then.description: Workshop should set zero_classification before M1; not enforced at prep time.
